But as the school’s stern principal closes in and the Battle of the Bands looms, Dewey must risk everything to prove that rock 'n' roll can change lives.

omdb.Title: Marsupilami
omdb.Writer: Philippe Lacheau, Pierre Dudan, Julien Arruti
omdb.Actors: Philippe Lacheau, Jamel Debbouze, Tarek Boudali
omdb.Plot: To save his job, David agrees to an unusual scheme: bringing back a mysterious package from South America. He finds himself on a cruise with his ex-girlfriend Tess, his son Leo, and his bumbling, clueless colleague Stéphane, whom David is using to transport the package in his place. Everything goes wrong when Stéphane accidentally opens it: a baby marsupilami appears, and the trip descends into chaos.
